name: WCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own title history lists 80 entries for the World Heavyweight Championship, from Vampiro to Mark Jindrak. 13 of them carry dates, from 28 October 2006 to 11 May 2008; the rest carry only their number. Its footnote 8 says: 'Sting unifies WCW and WWF world titles'. Its footnote 16 says: 'Edge unifies WCW and WWE world titles by defeating Chris Jericho (WWE world champion)'. The TNA fan federation's news of 8 June 2008 says it acquired the 'Big Gold' Championship with WCW's property.
notes: The fed's own WCW belt as its title history lists it, never the real belt.

name: WCW World Tag Championship
epitaph: The fed's own title history lists 30 entries for the World Tag Championship, from Hardy Boys to Elite (Robert Roode & Lance Cade). 21 of them carry dates, from 24 March 2002 to 14 January 2008; the rest carry only their number. Its footnote 1 says: 'Titles retired 3-24-03'. Its heading note says the history of the champions before the first listed team was erased.
notes: The fed's own WCW belt as its title history lists it, never the real belt.

name: WCW Six Man Tag Championship

notes: The fed's own WCW belt as its title history lists it, never the real belt.

That history is lost; however, notable champions were Bam Bam Bigelow, Kurt Angle, and many more.'
